content.rendered:
The Scholastic Book Fair will be held at Middleton from October 24th-27th. Students will be able to shop during their library times during the week of the 24th. On the first day of school conferences, Thursday, October 27th, the book fair will be open for families to visit and shop from 8:00 am to 8:00 pm. To learn all things about the bookfair visit the Middleton Book Fair Page.

Parents can set up an eWallet to provide your students a cashless way to shop. Teachers also have an eWallet if you would like to donate to your child’s classroom to help build their classroom library.

Thank you in advance for supporting our book fair!
